The 493 unallocated Ituri deaths remain unallocated: 3888 named zone deaths plus 493 close on 4381. Blank daily cells remain null; printed zeros remain zero. Isiro prints a blank new-case cell with 2 CTE deaths among previously confirmed patients.
Contacts: 79.5% is 21512/27043 across six reporting provinces; Sud-Kivu is not listed. Ituri reports again after ND in SR149, so the fall from 81.0% mixes a denominator change with coverage.

Nord-Kivu: 471 hospitalized, 330 of them in CTE/CT for 374 beds (printed 88.2%) and 107 (22.7%) outside CTE/CT; 330+107=437 leaves 34 unexplained. The 88.2% is a CTE/CT-only rate; no all-census occupancy is inferred.
